title: Biggz AI content-addressed review record
description: A single event in the content-addressed review store — THE schema that governs every event file. The revision is NOT stored in the record: it IS the file name (SHA-256 of the canonical record bytes). The payload stays unconstrained at record level: each operation's payload is formalized by its own envelope schema (lens-result-event, refutation-event, ...). The genesis record's prevRevision is the empty string.
